items.summary: Bitdefender researchers identified a website claiming to let people play GTA VI on a Windows PC that tells visitors to press Win+R, paste a PowerShell command and run it. Our analysis found that the command leads to malware.

items.title: Healthcare Sector Disclosed 100 Ransomware Attacks in Q3
items.summary: Ransomware groups are running riot, with 353 disclosed attacks in Q3 2026 and 2,668 undisclosed attacks, an increase of 20% in disclosed attacks and an increase of 77% in undisclosed attacks from Q3 2025, according to the Q3 2026 State of Ransomware Report from BlackFog . More attacks were disclosed in Q3 2026 than in any other quarter since BlackFog began tracking ransomware attacks in 2020, and each month in Q3 had more disclosed attacks than any Q3 month in previous years. items.title: Two Incidents, One Lesson in Trust
items.summary: Optimizely unfortunately suffered two incidents in nine months, so clearly they must be doing something wrong and the answer to that is to buy a bigger firewall.

items.title: Over 100 Debian Packages Still Contain Distrusted CA Certificates Despite Security Updates
items.summary: A scan of a Debian package mirror found that more than 100 packages still contained copies of distrusted certificate authority (CA) certificates after Debian removed them from its system trust store. Debian developer Steve McIntyre posted the scan results to the Debian developer mailing list on November 19. The findings show why updating the operating system’s trust store does not necessarily change which certificates an application accepts.
